Cyclone Effect: Heavy Rains Expected for Another Three Days

Cyclone Dithwa is weakening, but its impact continues. The Meteorological Department has warned that several districts in Andhra Pradesh are likely to receive heavy to very heavy rainfall over the next three days. Red alerts have been issued, and the government has instructed officials to remain on high alert. Heavy rainfall is also being reported in Tirumala and Tirupati.
